say:3:1831104001:1.text: Don't even think about denying it! Even if I have to drag you before Lady Novaris, you're paying us back today!
say:3:1831104001:1.source_cn: 别想抵赖！就算要把你押到领主阁下面前去，今天也必须让你还钱！

choice_prompt:4:1831104001.text: Don't even think about denying it! Even if I have to drag you before Lady Novaris, you're paying us back today!
choice_prompt:4:1831104001.source_cn: 别想抵赖！就算要把你押到领主阁下面前去，今天也必须让你还钱！

say:5:1831104002:1.text: A manufactured "risk" like this? Not a chance!
say:5:1831104002:1.source_cn: 这种人为制造的“风险”，我不能接受！

say:6:1831104004:1.text: Investments go up and down. What business in this world guarantees a profit? Not among the living, not among the dead. You're a Graveborn—you should know that better than anyone.
say:6:1831104004:1.source_cn: 投资本来就是有赚有赔，天底下哪有稳赚不赔的生意？不管生...

say:7:1831104005:1.text: Besides, you still walked away with a 20% cut, didn't you? At the end of the day, you made money.
say:7:1831104005:1.source_cn: 再说了，你们现在不是还有百分之二十的收益吗？归根究底还...

say:8:1831104006:1.text: We could've made much more if you hadn't issued that shady notice!
say:8:1831104006:1.source_cn: 要是你们没发那份不合规的公告，我们本来能赚更多的！

say:9:1831104007:1.text: Shady? This isn't the Lightbearer Empire. Novaris has no investment regulations. Every notice we issue is completely legal and above board.
say:9:1831104007:1.source_cn: 不合规？这里又不是耀光帝国，诺珐斯可没有什么投资规定，...

say:10:1831104008:1.text: My advice is to take your winnings and walk away. And even if you wanted to recover the difference, what are you going to do? Take this all the way to Bantus? Everyone knows His Lordship hates trouble.
say:10:1831104008:1.source_cn: 我劝你们见好就收，否则就算你们想要回相差的利润，难不成...

say:11:1831104009:1.text: ... So what if we do take it to Bantus?!
say:11:1831104009:1.source_cn: ……就算要闹到班题斯去，那又怎么样？！

choice_prompt:12:1831104009.text: ... So what if we do take it to Bantus?!
choice_prompt:12:1831104009.source_cn: ……就算要闹到班题斯去，那又怎么样？！

say:14:1831104011:1.text: Given the situation in Novaris, the second you cross into Bantus, you'll probably get thrown straight into a dungeon.
say:14:1831104011:1.source_cn: 以诺珐斯现在的情况，你们一旦进入班题斯境内，恐怕立刻就...

say:15:1831104012:1.text: I'm genuinely trying to help you here. Really.
say:15:1831104012:1.source_cn: 我的劝告是真心实意地为你们好，真的。

say:16:1831104013:1.text: Hmph... I'll let you off the hook for today. But once relations between Novaris and Bantus stabilize, I'm coming back for every coin that belongs to me!
say:16:1831104013:1.source_cn: 哼……今天就先放过你，等诺珐斯和班题斯之间的关系稳定下...

say:17:1831104014:1.text: Fine by me! As long as you bother the Syndicate directly next time instead of picking on me!
say:17:1831104014:1.source_cn: 没问题，只要你直接去找黑金商会，不找我的麻烦就行！

say:18:1831104015:1.text: Hahaha! The Novaris branch blew up, and I've finally found a chance to get out of this dump!
say:18:1831104015:1.source_cn: 哈哈，诺珐斯分部爆炸，我总算找到机会离开这个破地方了——！

choice:12:0:1.text: They're allied. Bantus won't help you.
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 班题斯和黑金商会有合作，不可能帮你们
choice:12:0:1.male: They're allied. Bantus won't help you.
choice:12:0:1.female: They're allied. Bantus won't help you.

say:20:1831104003:1.text: B-but we won't know until we try!
say:20:1831104003:1.source_cn: 那、那也总要试试才知道！

choice:4:1:2.text: The Lady won't get involved in something like this.
choice:4:1:2.male: The Lady won't get involved in something like this.
choice:4:1:2.female: The Lady won't get involved in something like this.
